text:
maria: Quick check — we need to lock slot allocations for the dedicated capacity wave this week. Procurement gave tentative ETA 2026-05-14, but infra needs CRs merged before we schedule provisioning. Who owns the final merge approvals?

ajay: I can take ownership of the infra-side CRs (networking, storage layout). I still need a +1 on the autoscaler change from runtime. @sarah?

sarah: I reviewed the autoscaler PR yesterday, left one tiny nit about backoff windows. If we push a fix today it's safe. I'll try to get a follow-up review in the next 2 hrs.

leo: Heads up — power allocation for rack P3 is still pending from facilities. That blocks bringing up 4 nodes (est 1.2MW tie-in). I pinged facilities last night.

toni: For reservations, the allocation IDs we plan to use are: resv-wave7-staging and resv-wave7-prod. Please don't reuse resv-wave6 names.

maria: Thanks. @leo can you confirm if facilities will greenlight by EOD? If not, we need fallback slots in us-west-2.

leo: Facilities replied: "can confirm on 05/12, earliest crew 05/13" — not ideal. I'd prefer fallback.

deploy-bot: Merge queue length: 3. Oldest pending deployable PR: #4578 (runtime autoscaler). ETA: ~3h if reviewers +1.

ajay: So plan: Sarah lands autoscaler fix, I merge infra CRs, Maria schedules provisioning for us-west-2 fallback for 05/14 if facilities doesn't confirm by noon UTC. Does that sound right?

sarah: Yep. I'll push the fix in ~30m and request reviewers. Quick note: change is just altering default backoff from 1s -> 500ms for short bursts.

maria: Good. Also, action item — @toni please make sure reservation TTLs are set to 21d for staging and 90d for prod in the reservation system. I want automatic cleanup if we don't consume.

toni: Will do. I'll run:
```
resvctl create --id resv-wave7-staging --pool staging --count 8 --ttl 21d
resvctl create --id resv-wave7-prod --pool prod --count 24 --ttl 90d
```
I'll post audit IDs when created.

ajay: If facilities confirms, do we want to use dedicated hardware in P3 or still prefer mixing with fallback? My vote: try P3 first but keep fallback reserved for immediate failover.

maria: Agreed. Prioritize P3 but keep fallback hot. One more dependency: storage team needs onboarding ticket for LVM config on the new nodes. @sarah can you file that or should I?

sarah: I can file it. I'll include expected device names and LVM layout: 4 x 8TB NVMe per node, vg name "inference-data", lv sizes 30T cache / remaining for ephemeral.

leo: Noted. Also request that rack install crew brings spare power PDUs — last wave we were short one.

maria: OK action summary: (1) sarah -> autoscaler fix + storage onboarding ticket (2) ajay -> merge infra CRs once autoscaler is green (3) toni -> create reservations with TTLs and post audit IDs (4) leo -> confirm facilities by noon UTC and request PDUs (5) maria -> schedule provisioning for fallback if no confirmation. I'll follow up ~12:15 UTC.

ajay: Thanks, all. I'll watch the queue and ping reviewers on #eng-reviews. :thumbsup:

sarah: Fix pushed, PR #4589 -> requesting reviews now.

deploy-bot: PR #4589 passed CI (unit+integration). Oldest pending mergeable PRs: #4578, #4601.

maria: Great. Closing loop — if anyone hits a blocker please post in this thread and @maria to escalate.

toni: Reservations created: audit 8312 (staging), audit 8313 (prod). Posted to infra-ops.

leo: Facilities updated: crew available 05/13 morning, PDUs confirmed. Seems we can proceed with P3.

maria: Awesome — thanks team. I'll update the roadmap doc and notify Solutions for customer handoffs.

ajay: Merged infra CRs at 1759999201.

sarah: Autoscaler PR merged at 1759999225.

maria: Last message: provisioning scheduled for 05/13 09:00 local facility time for P3, fallback hold until 05/14 03:00 UTC.

leo: Copy that.

maria: :rocket:
